terbaru.judul: On a phenotype-structured Shigesada--Kawasaki--Teramoto model: Turing instability and pattern selection under fast phenotype switching
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we present a generalised phenotype-structured formulation of the SKT model that accounts for phenotypic variability.

terbaru.judul: Oxygenation and spatial heterogeneity shape radiotherapy protocol ranking through phenotypic adaptation
terbaru.pelajaran: Under spatially uniform oxygenation, we find that alternative fractionation schedules provide little improvement over standard-of-care protocols in normoxic conditions.
We study the fixation location for neutral evolution, for the colonization process, and, more generally, for constant selection on small graphs, cycles, tori, random graphs, and island populations.

terbaru.judul: Fitness Inference in Presence of Migrations between Coupled Evolving Populations
terbaru.pelajaran: Using whole-genome time-series data generated through FFPopSim, we demonstrate that the QLE phase persists under conditions of sufficiently low migration rates.

terbaru.judul: Lamarckian Inheritance in Dynamic Environments: How Key Variables Affect Evolutionary Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we show that the benefit of Lamarckian inheritance depends on two variables: how conflicting the environmental changes are to robot control, and the predictability of those changes for the robotic agent.

terbaru.judul: CHE-TKG: Collaborative Historical Evidence and Evolutionary Dynamics Learning for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
terbaru.pelajaran: To address this, we propose CHE-TKG, a novel collaborative dual-view learning framework for TKG reasoning.

terbaru.judul: Distribution-Free Pretraining of Classification Losses via Evolutionary Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose Evolutionary Dynamic Loss (EDL), a framework that learns a transferable classification loss in the probability space using unlimited synthetic prediction-label pairs, without accessing real samples during the main loss pretraining stage.

terbaru.judul: Equilibrium and Competition in Evolutionary Dynamics
terbaru.pelajaran: We study deterministic polymer growth in which each finite sequence is followed along its genealogical structure.

terbaru.judul: Incorporating the underuse problem in the tragedy of the commons
terbaru.pelajaran: The tragedy of the commons has traditionally been framed as a problem of resource overuse driven by self-interested exploitation.

terbaru.judul: Population Dynamics in ARIEL Robotics Systems Featuring Embodied Evolution via Spatial Mating Mechanisms
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a Spatially Embedded Evolutionary Algorithm where robot individuals exist in a physically simulated 2D environment, must navigate to encounter potential mates, and compete for survival under various spatially-aware selection pressures.
